world_events: Aug 28: Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole speech signaled rate hike likely. Sep 16: FOMC raised rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% (12-0 unanimous). Dec hike possible per dot plot. 10yr Treasury at 5.16%. Iran-US war ongoing -- Hormuz remains restricted, US naval blockade halting Iranian oil exports (WSJ Sep 7). Brent crude at $105, WTI $93.62. Iran-Oman Hormuz route negotiations continuing but full reopening not agreed. Section 301 tariff replacement for Section 122 still pending finalization.
notes: Quarterly review (target: Sep 18). Satellite overtook Core this period (Satellite +29.70% vs Core +19.93%) driven by HOOD +58% and BMNR +57% -- both thesis-free satellite bets. Core shift: PL retreated from Jun peak (+106% to +17%) while COPX +37% and TSNF +17% rose on F-axis energy thesis playing out. Structure rebalancing from PL momentum to energy/materials thesis. Rate hike environment pressuring growth stocks (PL, IONQ). Total +23.89%, failure condition not triggered.
